title: Spanwit Space Report v1
description: Read-only disk diagnostic report from spanwit space --format json. Never includes an execute/delete path. Section boundaries enforce trust-state placement for future API consumers.

min_size.description: Opt-in size floor display; "none" when unset.

max_depth.description: Bound on name-shaped unverified and verified discovery depth under root.

sort_mode.description: Ranking policy for verified candidates (advisory only).

reclaim_scope.description: Plan-wide reclaim granularity; carried into exact_plan for replay.

mutation_contract.description: Effective invocation mutation contract (read_only when no-mutation assertion is active).

include_temp.description: Whether space --include-temp requested verified temp walk roots. Absent or false: no temp candidates.

pressure.description: Primary write/home volume capacity (not necessarily the analysis root mount).

analysis_pressure.description: Present when the analysis root is on a different volume than pressure.

prunable_bound.description: Bound of prunable_bytes: lower when any prunable candidate size is incomplete, else exact. Never lower when size_incomplete is false. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

withheld_bound.description: Bound of withheld_bytes: lower when any withheld candidate size is incomplete, else exact. Never lower when size_incomplete is false. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

size_incomplete.description: True when any candidate size is a depth-bounded partial measurement; byte totals are lower bounds only.
True when any full-set unverified entry was depth-bounded; total_bytes is a lower bound even if incomplete rows are top-truncated out of entries.

size_bound.description: Bound of total_bytes: exact, or lower when size_incomplete is true. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

prune_handoff.description: Optional prune handoff: prunable-only rows from this report (the dry-run for those paths) plus allowlist revalidate commands. Never includes diagnostic-only mass.

recipes.description: Optional guided recipes for diagnostic-only cleanup. Suggested external commands only; never executable by spanwit.

applied_filters.description: Present when opt-in --class/--domain projection was applied. Distinguishes honestly empty filtered views from unfiltered empty inventory.

enabled_domains.description: Resolved domains.enabled policy set (authorize-narrow): which use domains may drive recipes and reclaim. Present only when the config supplied a domains block; absent means the built-in default. This is policy, not the --domain view projection.

applied_filters.description: Canonical inventory projection. Both arrays are always present (possibly empty) when the object is set.

volume_id.description: Opaque filesystem identity for same-volume comparison across platforms.

bytes_bound.description: Bound of total_bytes, used_bytes and avail_bytes: exact for the one statfs sample taken at generated_at. Not stable over time; other writers change the volume between samples. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

size_bound.description: Bound of the size figure: exact, or lower when size_incomplete is true (the figure is an observed minimum). Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

last_activity_at.description: Newest observed descendant file mtime (RFC3339). Advisory ranking only.

domain.description: Derived from signature taxonomy spine (domain segment).

ecosystem.description: Derived from signature taxonomy spine (ecosystem segment).

catalog_id.description: Optional full-spine id; verified rows normally use signature instead.

recipe_ids.description: Optional stable linkage to guided recipes.

size_bound.description: Bound of the size figure: exact, or lower when size_incomplete is true (the figure is an observed minimum). Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

catalog_id.description: Provisional full-spine catalog id for inventory filters.

size_bound.description: Bound of the size figure: exact, or lower when size_incomplete is true (the figure is an observed minimum). Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

Bound of the size figure: exact, or lower when size_incomplete is true (the figure is an observed minimum). Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

Bound of prunable_bytes: exact, or lower when size_incomplete is true (some candidate size is an observed minimum). Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

temp_exact_plans.description: One exact plan per admitted temp root (space --include-temp), each with that root as its analysis_root. prune re-admits each root at prune time before revalidating its candidates.

size_bound.description: Bound of the size figure: exact, or lower when size_incomplete is true (the figure is an observed minimum). Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

exact_plan.description: Policy-preserving exact-path plan for prune --from-space-report revalidation.

size_bound.description: Bound of the size figure: exact, or lower when size_incomplete is true (the figure is an observed minimum). Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

state.description: Recipes are always diagnostic-only; never prunable.

kind.description: argv (default when omitted) is a single-shot external-command suggestion; structural is a multi-step print-only journey (016A).

steps.description: Ordered steps for kind=structural recipes. Print-only; never auto-executed. Go load rejects argv recipes with steps and structural recipes without steps.

exact_plan.description: Optional closed-set revalidation plan scoped to this recipe (e.g. Cargo-only). Revalidate with prune --from-exact-plan; not the report-wide prune_handoff.

catalog_id.description: Full-spine taxonomy id for domain filtering (e.g. development.rust.rustup).

recipe_step.description: One ordered step in a structural guided recipe. Print-only; spanwit never writes config or deletes.

config_snippet.description: Copy-paste config fragment. Never written by spanwit.

suggested_command.description: Machine-safe argv form plus shell-safe display line. Never auto-executed by spanwit.

temp_plane_coverage.description: OS temp roots this run did not walk, present only under warn/critical primary pressure. Observation only: carries no prune authority and never names children.

size_bytes.description: Exact when measured; lower bound when partial; absent when unavailable.

size_bound.description: Bound of size_bytes: exact when measured, lower when partial, absent when unavailable. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

follow_up.description: Root-level space command for the operator to run explicitly.

completion.description: Whether the requested observation finished without coverage warnings. Mirrors the CLI exit contract (complete=0, partial=1). Never deletion authority.

temp_residue_summary.description: Aggregate of the direct children of the listed temp roots, keyed by fixed product labels. Never names children: a family label is fixed vocabulary, never derived from an entry name, and any entry outside the table is counted under 'other'. Hidden (dot-prefixed) entries are included in every total.

skipped_entries.description: Listed children that could not be stat'd. They appear in no family row; a family that lost an entry states bytes_bound lower. Absent when none were skipped.

entries.description: Observed entries in this family; at least one (a family with no measured entry has no row).

bytes.description: Sum of each entry's own lstat size (a directory record, not its contents). Entry counts are the signal; the temp plane probe owns content sizing.

bytes_bound.description: Bound of bytes. bytes is the sum of each listed entry's own lstat size (symlinks count 0), read without descending. exact when every listed entry was measured; lower when an entry could not be stat'd and was left out of the sum. It is not a content size. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

container_runtime.description: Container engine storage headroom. Diagnostic-only and propose-only: adds no prune candidates. Aggregates by kind; image refs appear only under ref_disclosure=local.

guest_filesystem.description: Statfs of the engine data root as seen by the engine (inside the VM for VM-backed engines).

bound.description: Bound of total_bytes, used_bytes and avail_bytes: exact for the one statfs sample at capture, not stable over time. Present when status is measured, absent otherwise. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

buckets.description: At most one bucket per kind.

recipe.description: Ordered by cost_class: none, rebuild, re_pull, data_loss_risk; guest_trim and disk_grow last. Each estimate states its bound.

container_runtime_bucket.description: One bucket of engine storage, aggregated by kind. Never names images, volumes or containers.

bytes.description: Total bytes attributed to the bucket. For images this is the engine-reported deduplicated layer total; unique_bytes is the reclaim estimate.

unique_bytes.description: Bytes held only by members of this bucket; the honest upper bound on what removing them alone frees.

reclaimable_bytes.description: Engine-reported reclaimable bytes (build cache not in use).

bound.description: Bound of every byte figure in the bucket: exact, as reported by the engine API at capture. Present when status is measured, absent when unavailable. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

container_runtime_recipe_step.description: One cost-ordered relief step. Steps are suggestions only; spanwit never runs them.

estimate.description: Estimated bytes this step frees inside the engine. bound states the direction: lower means at least, upper means at most. Host reclaim also depends on trim.

command.description: Generic argv for the step. Never contains an image ref, volume name, profile or host path.

container_runtime_image_ref.description: One image reference. Present only under ref_disclosure=local; local operator view, never for publish or commit surfaces.

bound.description: Bound of unique_bytes: exact, as reported by the engine API at capture. Optional in the schema so reports written before bounds existed still load; every report spanwit emits carries it.

temp_root.description: One candidate temp root for space --include-temp: whether it was admitted as a verified walk root, and if not, why. Roots only; never child names. Admission requires a canonical, non-shared, current-uid-owned, exactly-0700 directory that is not a symlink, under a parent no one else can write, with euid not 0 and no overlap with the analysis root.
